title: AURORA Link
description: A link represents a directional relationship between two cards, or from a card to an external URL. Links are untyped; their semantic meaning depends on the current view or interpretation context.

source_id.description: ID of the source card (origin of the link)

target_id.description: ID of the target card (destination of the link). Null if target is external URL.

target_url.description: External URL if target is not a card. Null if target is internal card.

metadata.description: Optional metadata about the link (weight, confidence, view-specific annotations)

weight.description: Optional weight or strength indicator for the link

view_context.description: Optional context indicating which view or interpretation applies to this link

link_title.description: Optional display title for external links
